content: Yen biru Dɑfidi u mɑɑ kpɑm dɑ u kukuɑ Adulɑmun kpee wɔruɔ. Ye win tundon yɛnuɡibu kpuro bɑ nuɑ mɑ u kukuɑ mi, yerɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ win mi.
Mɑ be bɑ dibu nɛni, kɑ be bɑ dɑm dɔremɔ kɑ be bɑ ǹ nuku dobu mɔ, bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑ win mi, bɑ nùn kuɑ ben kpɑro. Ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnu nɛɛrun (400) sɑkɑ.
Sɑɑ min diyɑ Dɑfidi u dɑ Misipɑɔ Mɔɑbun temɔ, mɑ u tem min sunɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ de nɛn tundo kɑ nɛn mɛro bu nɑ bɑ n kukuɑ wunɛn mini sere n kɑ ɡiɑ ye Gusunɔ u koo kɑ mɑn ko.
Mɑ sunɔ u wurɑ. Yerɑ Dɑfidi u kɑ win tundo kɑ win mɛro dɑ sunɔ win mi. Miyɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere n kɑ kuɑ win sɑɑ kpuro ye u kukuɑ kperu mi.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Gɑdi u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kun wɑ̃ɑ kpee wɔru ɡeni sɔɔ. A seewo ɑ dɑ Yudɑn temɔ kpɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi. Mɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Herɛtiɔ.
Sɔɔlu u derɑ
bɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu ɡo
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Sɔɔlu u dɑ u sɔ̃ dɑ̃ru ɡɑrun nuurɔ Gibeɑɔ ɡunɡuru ɡɑrun mi, u win yɑɑsɑ nɛni, mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn sikerenɛ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ u Dɑfidi kɑ win tɔmbun lɑbɑɑri nuɑ.

Yerɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑ be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ nɛɡibu, Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bweseru, i swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ. I tɑmɑɑ Isɑin bii u koo bɛɛ resɛm ɡbɑɑru wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ nɑ bɛɛ wɛ̃, kpɑ u bɛɛn bɑɑwure ko tɔmbu wunɔbu (100) ǹ kun mɛ nɔrɔbun (1.000) wiruɡii?

Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i mɑn seesi. Domi bɛɛn ɡoo kun mɑn dɔmɛyɛ ɑrukɑwɑni ye nɛn bii Yonɑtɑm u kɑ Isɑin bii Dɑfidi bɔkuɑ. Bɛɛn ɡoo kun mɑɑ mɑn wɔnwɔndu kue, u mɑn sɔ̃ bwisi yi nɛn bii u Dɑfidi kɑ̃ u kɑ mɑn yinɑ bɛriɑ nɡe mɛ u mɔ̀ ɡisɔ.
N deemɑ Dɔɛɡu Edɔmu wi, u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Sɔɔlun bwɑ̃ɑbu sɑnnu dɔmɑ te. Yerɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ Isɑin bii wi wɑ Nɔbuɔ Akimɛlɛki, Akitubun biin mi.
Mɑ Akimɛlɛki wi, u nùn bikiɑru kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn mi. Yen biru u nùn dĩɑnu wɛ̃ kɑ mɑɑ Goliɑtin tɑkobi ye.
Ye Sɔɔlu u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u derɑ bɑ Akimɛlɛki Akitubun bii wi sokusiɑ kɑ win yɛnuɡibu, be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu Nɔbuɔ. Mɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ nɑ sunɔn mi.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, Akimɛlɛki, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ. Yerɑ Akimɛlɛki u wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nɔɔmɔ, yinni.

Sɔɔlu u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ i mɑn seesi, wunɛ kɑ Isɑin bii. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ nùn dĩɑnu kɑ tɑkobi wɛ̃. Yen biru ɑ nùn bikiɑru kuɑ Gusunɔn mi, u kɑ mɑn seesi, kpɑ u mɑn yinɑ bɛriɑ nɡe mɛ u mɔ̀ ɡisɔ.
Akimɛlɛki u sunɔ wisɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu kpuro sɔɔ, wɑrɑ u rɑ nun wiru kpĩiyɛ nɡe wunɛn dokiri Dɑfidi wi u rɑ wunɛn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ wunɛn yɛnuɡibu bɑ rɑ n nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Gisɔrɑ nɑ bikiɑru toruɑ Yinni Gusunɔn mi win sɔ̃? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, yinni, ɑ ku mɑn ɡɑri yini sɔbi, ǹ kun mɛ nɛn yɛnuɡii ɡoo. Nɑ ǹ yi yɛ̃, bɑɑ fiiko.
Yerɑ sunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kon bɛɛ ɡowɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛɡibu kpuro.

Mɑ u win tɑbu kowo be bɑ nùn kɔ̃su sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i susimɑ i mɑn Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku kowo beni ɡoowɑ, yèn sɔ̃ ben tii bɑ Dɑfidi nɔmɑ kɑ̃. Bɑ mɑɑ yɛ̃ mɑ u mɑn dukɑ suuriwɑ. Mɑ bɑ ǹ nɛ bu mɑn sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ tɑbu kowo be, bɑ yinɑ bu Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku kowo be ɡo.
Yerɑ n derɑ u Dɔɛɡu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ susimɑ, kpɑ ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku kowo be ɡo. Mɑ u susi u bu ɡo. Yen dɔmɑ te, yɑ̃ku kowobu wɛnɛ kɑ nɔɔbuwɑ u ɡo be bɑ ben sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃nu doke.
Sɔɔlu u mɑɑ derɑ bɑ Nɔbuɡibu ɡo, kurɔbu kɑ durɔbu, sere kɑ bii wɛ̃ɛnɔ, kɑ yɑɑ sɑbenɔ, niyɑ kɛtɛbɑ kɑ kɛtɛkunu kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu. N deemɑ wuu ɡe, ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun wuu.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ tɔn be ɡoomɔ, bɑ ǹ Akimɛlɛkin bii turo Abiɑtɑɑ nɔmɑ turɑ. Domi u dukɑ suɑ u doonɑ Dɑfidin mi ɡiɑ.
Ye u turɑ Dɑfidin mi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Sɔɔlu u Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku kowobu ɡo.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u Abiɑtɑɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑɑ dɔmɑ tèn di nɑ Dɔɛɡu Edɔmu wɑ, u wɑ̃ɑ mi, nɑ yɛ̃ kɑm kɑm mɑ u koo dɑ u Sɔɔlu nɛn lɑbɑɑri sɔ̃. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, nɛnɑ nɑ derɑ bɑ wunɛn yɛnuɡibu kpuro ɡo.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ sinɔ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ nɛ. A ku nɑndɑ, domi wi u kɑsu u nun ɡo mi, nɛn tiiwɑ yɛ̃ro u mɑɑ kɑsu u ɡo. À n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɛn bɔkuɔ, kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ɑlɑfiɑ sɔɔ.
